behavior: An arrow in a popup with a CSS `zoom` points at the center of its anchor. Its place and `arrowPadding` are in the pixels of its nearest positioned ancestor. A Select popup over the trigger with a `zoom` puts the text of the selected item over the text of the value. In the Popover demo of Base UI, a `zoom: 2` on the popup moves the arrow 225 px off the center of the trigger.
